About

Japan 2026

About this guide

This site is a personal travel planning guide for a Spring 2026 trip to Japan, covering two destinations — the alpine meadows of Yatsugatake and the electric streets of Tokyo. It was built with Astro and hosted on GitHub Pages, inspired by Mariatta's Portugal trip guide.

The itinerary

8 nights total across two stops:

Yatsugatake — May 1–4, 3 nights in the highland plateau around Kobuchizawa and Kiyosato.

Tokyo — May 4–9, 5 nights exploring temples, neighbourhoods, ramen, and everything in between.

Languages

This guide is available in three languages — English, Traditional Chinese (繁體中文), and Japanese (日本語). Use the tabs in the navigation bar to switch between them at any time. Your preference is saved automatically.

Built with

  • Astro — static site framework
  • Leaflet — interactive maps
  • OpenStreetMap — map tiles
  • Cormorant Garamond & Jost — typography
  • GitHub Pages — hosting
